_comment: Aura definitions. An aura is a field around a unit that affects other units by proximity. Any source may declare one with an `aura` key naming an id here: an item (passive_aura), a status (aura), a perk (aura), or a spell/active skill (aura, which applies its carrier status). What it does is a list of effects in the shared effect language, under `while_inside`: a `modify` is READ wherever the number is used (ValuePaths, Resistance), so walking out of the aura ends it with nothing to undo; every other effect fires once on the emitter's turn, through EffectResolver. An item may override the aura's flat numbers with `aura_value` (signed: a negative one drains). A status's own value reaches an effect through {"from": "status.value"}. Resolution lives in scripts/combat/aura_system.gd; EffectVocab.validate_aura checks every definition.
_comment_radius: Radius is in grid tiles, Chebyshev distance, and never includes the emitter unless `affects` is 'self' or `self_included` is true.
_comment_affects: allies | enemies | all | self. `invert_for_enemies` flips the sign of every number for units on the other team (a multiply of 0.8 becomes 1.2), which is how one declaration expresses 'helps my side, hurts theirs'. The aura's effects carry no `to` of their own: who they reach is the aura's question.

auras._comment_immune_system: A `resistance` payload names what it guards against in `type`, which may be a damage type or an affliction. Immune System guards against three afflictions — things that happen to you rather than things that hit you — so its 15 reads as a 15% chance not to catch them, through Resistance.resists_affliction().

light_aura.name: Light of the Sun
light_aura._comment: Solar_Form declared this effect string for months with no consumer anywhere. Dazzling nearby enemies is the reading the status description already implied.

initiative_debuff.name: Weight of the Khatvanga
initiative_debuff._comment: Khatvanga items override the magnitude per consecration grade, -2 through -8.

avatar_of_the_storm.name: Avatar of the Storm
avatar_of_the_storm._comment: Party-wide rather than proximity-based, hence the radius. The air damage and stun chance this perk also grants stay in the on-hit path; only the standing bonus is an aura.

radiance_glare.name: Radiant Glare
radiance_glare._comment: The melee half of Radiance. Separate from the healing half because they reach different teams at different radii, which one aura cannot do.

radiant_visage.name: Radiant Visage
radiant_visage._comment: The spell described +2 AWR and +2 CON. Those are attributes, and an aura moves stats — so it grants what they would have bought: the initiative from Awareness and the health from Constitution.

shining_mirage.name: Shining Mirage
shining_mirage._comment: Battlefield-wide, and resistible. Each enemy who makes the save sees a little further through it, so the DC they personally face drops by 2 every time — the mirage wears out against anyone who keeps their head.

auras._comment_shield_wall: Shield Wall is two auras on one status (Shield_Wall), because the wall and its cover want different amounts. The amount is {pct_of: target.armor, value: 25}: a percentage of the receiving unit's OWN sheet Armor - +25% of your Armor, +10% of each adjacent ally's - which a flat number cannot express.

_comment_immune_system: Immune System guards against three afflictions — things that happen to you rather than things that hit you — with `resist.poison`, `resist.bleed` and `resist.disease`. Its 15 reads as a 15% chance not to catch them (Resistance.resists_affliction) and, for poison, 15% off poison damage too (Resistance.total).
